request.goal: Minimize the full training step_ms of the original FP32 GPT-2 Medium FSDP2 workload, preserving the source's full two-rank global batch, logits, gradient and two-update parameter quality, numerical policy, completion boundaries and peak_allocated_bytes <=1.05 baseline constraint. Collect applicable communication diagnostics to understand this distributed task. Implementation choices may change when full semantics and the memory budget are preserved.
notes: Command provenance: user command 'torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 train.py --output /tmp/fsdp-source --profile' (intent.json), matching README.md:3. --output is a required harness artifact directory (framework supplies its own path, not /tmp/fsdp-source as a semantic value); --profile enables the 3 diagnostic communication profile invocations.

The workload object is the complete workload.json row copied verbatim with the project's exact field names (model, world_size, batch_per_rank, sequence_length, seed, learning_rate, warmup, repeats, profile_repeats, quality, objective); it is not wrapped in a new envelope.

Quality semantics are source-required (train.py verify(), 97-137; README.md:10-16): an independent unsharded serial global-batch reference runs quality.continuous_updates=2 complete updates; each reference update accumulates every rank's forward with (loss/world_size).backward(); per step, the actual run's loss, complete logits, every parameter gradient and every post-update parameter must match the reference at atol 1e-6 / rtol 1e-4 (torch.allclose plus finiteness, train.py compare()). Gradients and parameters are compared in their actual DTensor shard layout per rank (reference_shard, train.py:80-86): FSDP shards are different parts of one parameter, not replicas equal across ranks. Discrete exact checks: logits+1 must FAIL the comparison (negative control, train.py:125) and transformer.wte.weight is lm_head.weight must remain true (tied embeddings, train.py:127); the source run fails hard if any check fails (train.py:166-167).

Numerical policy is a semantic requirement (goal statement; README.md:4-6; train.py policy() 20-26 and build_model 29-33): FP32 everywhere, TF32 off for cuda.matmul and cudnn, torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest'), cudnn.benchmark False, eager attention, dropout 0, use_cache False. No generation is involved (use_cache False, labels=input_ids LM loss).

Baseline implementation choices, not frozen requirements (README.md:18-21): the bottom-up per-transformer-block fully_shard FSDP2 strategy, default prefetch scheduling, no manual serialization/barriers, the optimizer implementation and foreach=False grouping, and CPU thread settings (torch.set_num_threads(4), set_num_interop_threads(1)). Semantics-equivalent alternatives are allowed provided the entire work, the quality tolerances above and the peak_allocated_bytes <= 1.05x baseline budget are preserved.

Measurement definition (train.py measured(), 140-148): reset() of all parameters to initial values and zero_grad happen outside timing, then dist.barrier(), torch.cuda.synchronize(), torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(), and wall-clock time.perf_counter_ns around step() closed by a trailing torch.cuda.synchronize(); peak_allocated_bytes and allocated_bytes are sampled while the step's returned loss/logits are still referenced. Aggregation (train.py:169-171): max across ranks per aligned invocation index, then median across the repeats, i.e. ranks_then_samples, matching README.md:23-24. warmup=2 and repeats=5 are the harness's statistical repetitions, outside the per-invocation work.

Communication diagnostics (requested by the goal) are separate profiled invocations, not part of clean timing: workload.json profile_repeats=3; train.py:173-179 does reset, barrier, synchronize, then a torch.profiler CPU+CUDA trace around one step() labeled 'source.complete_training_step' and exports a chrome trace. Sampled via the installed torch_communication collector (deployment.json metric_collectors); communication_kernel_sum_ms includes waiting and is neither wire time nor an exposed critical-path bound (README.md:28-30). Collector availability must be verified by the actual workload worker; failed collection is an error, never a fabricated zero. Profile invocations are rank-aligned (barrier+synchronize), justifying ranks_then_samples aggregation.
--api-fixture (train.py:158-159) shrinks the model to a 2-layer/128-hidden developer API check; it is not this task and does not affect acceptance (README.md:31-32).

Artifacts written by a full source run (quality-rank-N.json, source-step-i-rank-N.pt observation tensors, profile-i-rank-N.json traces, result-rank-N.json) are measurement/report infrastructure, not part of the timed work; the framework supplies output paths.

No external model weights or datasets: the model is constructed from GPT2Config under torch.manual_seed(20261028) and inputs are synthetic torch.randint from fixed per-rank seeds (train.py:29-39); assets are empty (README.md:6-7).

device_count 2 equals the asserted world_size (train.py:160) and --nproc-per-node=2, using the two leased RTX 4090 GPUs; the worker handles rank/device binding and NCCL process-group initialization (train.py:156-157).

Environment verified on the measured worker's Python (/root/autodl-tmp/dev-venv/bin/python, torch 2.13.0+cu129, transformers 5.16.1): torch.distributed.fsdp.fully_shard, DTensor, GPT2Config/GPT2LMHeadModel import and the config kwargs, eager attention override and default tied wte/lm_head weights all work.

One measured invocation: Per rank (world_size 2, one CUDA GPU per rank, NCCL process group), one complete FSDP training step, exactly train.py step() (train.py:66-71): (1) optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True); (2) full rank-local forward of the sharded FP32 GPT-2 Medium (workload.json model: n_layer 24, n_embd 1024, n_head 16, vocab_size 50257, n_positions 1024; all dropout 0, eager attention, use_cache False) on this rank's seeded input (batch_per_rank 1 x sequence_length 128, torch.randint drawn from generator seed 20261028+100+rank) with labels=input_ids, producing loss and the complete logits tensor; (3) loss.backward() with FSDP distributed gradient reduction so resulting gradients equal the global mean over the two-rank global batch (2 sequences total, effective batch preserved); (4) one SGD update with lr 0.001, momentum 0., weight_decay 0. (foreach=False is the source's baseline optimizer grouping, not a requirement; SGD hyperparameters are required.) Required numerical policy: FP32 parameters and compute, TF32 disabled for both cuda.matmul and cudnn, float32_matmul_precision 'highest', cudnn.benchmark False. Completion boundary: torch.cuda.synchronize() before and after the step (both CUDA completion boundaries), and the step's detached loss and full logits must remain alive until after peak allocated memory is sampled (train.py measured(), 140-148). Seeded init (torch.manual_seed(20261028) before GPT2LMHeadModel(config)) and tied transformer.wte.weight/lm_head.weight are required semantics. Outside the measured invocation: restoring initial seeded parameters and zeroing grads (train.py reset(), 58-63), barriers and peak-memory-stat reset, reference construction and quality verification, statistical warmup/repeats, communication profiling, and report/artifact writing.

usage.scope: Observed assistant message snapshots; provider estimates, not invoice

invariants: Numerical policy is required semantics (goal statement; README.md:4-6; train.py policy() 20-26 and build_model 29-33): FP32 parameters and compute everywhere, TF32 disabled for both torch.backends.cuda.matmul and torch.backends.cudnn, torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest'), cudnn.benchmark False.

Model semantics (train.py build_model 29-33; request workload.model): GPT-2 Medium from GPT2Config with n_layer 24, n_embd 1024, n_head 16, vocab_size 50257, n_positions 1024, resid_pdrop/attn_pdrop/embd_pdrop all 0, eager attention, use_cache False; initialization under torch.manual_seed(seed=20261028) immediately before GPT2LMHeadModel construction so independent workers reproduce identical weights; transformer.wte.weight is lm_head.weight (tied embeddings) must remain true (train.py:127, 166-167).

Task data (train.py inputs() 36-39; README.md:6-7; request assets empty): each rank's input is torch.randint(vocab_size, (batch_per_rank, sequence_length)) from a CPU torch.Generator seeded seed+100+rank; the two-rank global batch (effective 2 sequences) is frozen; no external model weights or datasets exist and none may be invented.

One invocation's work (train.py step() 66-71): zero_grad(set_to_none=True) inside the timed step, full rank-local forward with labels=input_ids producing loss and the complete logits tensor, loss.backward() with FSDP distributed gradient reduction so gradients equal the global mean over the two-rank global batch, and exactly one SGD update with lr 0.001, momentum 0., weight_decay 0. The SGD hyperparameters are required; the foreach=False grouping is a baseline implementation choice (request notes; README.md:18-21).

Quality semantics (train.py verify()/compare()/reference_shard() 80-137; README.md:10-16): over quality.continuous_updates=2 continuous updates, the actual loss, complete logits, every parameter gradient and every post-update parameter must match an independent unsharded serial global-batch reference (each reference update accumulates (loss/world_size).backward() for every rank's input) at atol 1e-6 / rtol 1e-4 with finiteness; gradients and parameters are compared in their actual per-rank DTensor shard layout because FSDP shards are different parts of one parameter, not replicas equal across ranks; the +1 corrupted-logits negative control must fail the comparison; the source fails hard when any check fails.

Completion and measurement boundaries (train.py measured() 140-148; README.md:23-26): the step is enclosed by CUDA synchronization before and after; the returned detached loss and full logits must remain alive until after peak_allocated_bytes and allocated_bytes are sampled; objective aggregation is max across ranks per aligned invocation, then median across repeats (ranks_then_samples).

Memory constraint (request objective.constraints; README.md:22-23): peak_allocated_bytes <= 1.05x the source baseline under the same max/ranks_then_samples aggregation, so the sharded task's memory budget must be retained by any change.

Reset and statistics are outside the timed work (train.py reset() 58-63, main() 168-171; README.md:16): every statistical repetition (warmup=2, repeats=5) starts from restored initial seeded parameters and zeroed grads; barriers, peak-stat resets, quality verification, communication profiling and artifact writing never run inside the timed step.

Communication semantics (train.py:173-179; README.md:28-30; request diagnostic_metrics): the distributed gradient reduction across the two NCCL ranks is required work inside the step; the four communication diagnostics (communication_kernel_sum_ms, communication_union_ms, compute_overlap_ms, communication_without_compute_ms) are separate profiled invocations sampled by the framework's torch_communication collector and must never be fabricated by the adapter.
